title: podman panics when providing an incomplete `RUN --mount=type=secret` directive
body:
### Issue Description

With the following Dockerfile:
```Dockerfile
FROM scratch

RUN --mount=type=secret,id,uid=1000=.netrc \
    set -eu
```
Executing `podman build .` generates:
```
panic: runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1
...
```



### Steps to reproduce the issue

Using the latest podman image from quay.io,
With the following Dockerfile:
```Dockerfile
FROM scratch

RUN --mount=type=secret,id,uid=1000=.netrc \
    set -eu
```
Executing `podman build .` generates:
```
panic: runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1
...
```

### Describe the results you received

```
panic: runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1
...
```

Looks like something I reported earlier in #28394

### Describe the results you expected

I am not expecting a panic

comments.body: Confirmed fix on current main: the same Containerfile now fails with a clear error (secret should have syntax id=id[,...]) instead of panicking. Fixed in Buildah via [buildah#6998](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/pull/6998) (same class of bug as #28394 / [buildah#6997](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/issues/6997)). Closing; please retry with a newer Podman that vendors that Buildah change. (Note: quay.io images are outdated.)
